answeredQuestions.business-outcomes: Faster case preparation, better consistency, earlier gap detection, and stronger traceability
answeredQuestions.governance-model: Human reviewers remain accountable for final decisions and escalation

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: Human-in-the-loop review, auditability, escalation, and evidence-grounded policy review are required.
The likely business value is faster, more consistent case review with risk controls rather than autonomous compliance decisions.
The target workflow is an internal review assistant for policy-sensitive case assessment, supported by traceability and escalation.
